review_scope: Primary read the full first-pass report and independently read the full generator and browser JavaScript. The reviewer read all remaining required files completely.
decision: Keep all four baseline labels. Capsule launch and collision use 3D trajectory geometry, gravity and evolving target positions. Aiming choices affect future contact and consume finite ammunition. Targets are generated ahead of the initial camera, their appearances are listed, and the renderer draws them after obstacle geometry; this task does not require a separate hidden-information search before targeting.

The visible CERTIFY ROUNDUP button submits an incomplete/failure attempt if clicked earlier; a successful screenshot-only solution should allow automatic completion, not click that button after the contacts.
rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: This No is based on the generated forward sanctuary and visible target cues, not on a claim that camera movement can never be exploration.

uncertainties: Source-based baseline labels and profile review; no all-seed human/agent calibration or dedicated temporal diagnostic was performed.
